title: Reject ambiguous coordination JSON before posting or reading claims
body:
Duplicate JSON keys currently use the last value without a warning. A post can therefore contain both HANDOFF and DONE while the board reads only one. Use one strict parser for fenced coordination blocks and `--metadata-file`. Reject duplicate keys and nonfinite JSON numbers before validation or posting. Valid prose and metadata remain unchanged.

Validation: 13 coordination tests pass; the 4 new regressions also pass under `-O`. Cases cover conflicting status/base keys, nested duplicate keys, nonfinite extension values, Unicode round trips and zero post calls on an invalid metadata file. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main, current priorities, open PR file lists and recent Discussions were checked; no active scope touches these files. This changes advisory metadata handling only. The initial hosted plan failed the two existing current-status navigation checks. Their repair is now in main through PR #5703.

This PR was integrated before the test-discovery correction. The integrated head below is the verified source for this PR. The four CI-registration renames are available in [PR #5749](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5749); its hosted log records all 69 new contribution tests as passing. The shared plan still has revision-8 task-picker failures, documented in [the contribution handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5722).

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `20bed137e8807376f3124dd6d03fc076e595b016`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
